question: The Dhamek Stupa is located in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Dhamek Stupa is a **huge stupa situated at Sarnath**, 13 km away from Varanasi in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• It is one of the most important **Buddhist structures** in India. 
 
• The Dhamek Stupa was constructed in **500 CE **to replace an earlier structure ordered by the great **Mauryan king Ashoka in 249 BCE.**
 
• The Dhamek Stupa represents the deer park.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tawang Monastery,** situated in Tawang city of Tawang district in the Indian state of **Arunachal Pradesh, is the largest monastery in India.**
 
• **Kesariya stupa** is a Buddhist stupa in Kesariya, situated at a distance of **110 kilometres from Patna, in the Champaran district of Bihar, India. **
 
• **Tabo Monastery** is situated in the Tabo village of Spiti Valley, **Himachal Pradesh**.​
